G2 partially arguable (FDA-aligned single-arm registrational design + BTD/RMAT is a concrete regulatory commitment) but it is already granted and public since Feb 2026, so it is backward-looking. G3 fails outright — the 33% (8/24) response threshold, the 47-milestone interim dataset, and the H2-2027 topline date are all fully disclosed and consensus-known, so there is no specific currently-unpriced figure.
verified.edge: L — every element of the thesis is public and re-rated. BTD (Feb 2026), dosing completion (Jun 8), and the 30-month interim data (Jun 29) all landed before this scan date, and the company followed with a ~$134.8M equity + pre-funded warrant raise in Jun-Jul 2026 that both removed the financing catalyst and added dilution. verified.primary_source: Neurogene press release via BioSpace, 2026-06-29 ("Neurogene Reports Positive Long-term Clinical Data from Phase 1/2 Trial of NGN-401"), data cutoff 2026-06-16; corroborated by Neurogene/BusinessWire 2026-06-08 dosing-completion release (topline guided H2-2027) and Neurogene 8-K 2026-02 (BTD grant).
verified.analysis: The triage premise is factually inverted: it claims "the readout window is upon us," but the mid-2026 interim Phase 1/2 Rett data fired on 2026-06-29 at the IRSF Scientific Meeting (47 milestones across 10 participants, 100% CGI-I improvement, durable through 30 months), and BTD was granted back in February 2026. What remains is Embolden topline in H2-2027 — dated, but roughly 13-18 months forward, far outside a tradeable dated-binary window, and the company de-risked its balance sheet with a ~$134.8M raise in Jun-Jul 2026 that extends runway into early 2029 while diluting holders. The science may well be good and the 33% response bar is genuinely low, but a known date, a known bar, a known dataset, and a freshly-funded balance sheet leave no unpriced figure to underwrite. Gap to note: I did not price the current option surface or check whether H2-2027 LEAPS exist at reasonable IV, but no instrument choice rescues a catalyst that has already fired.

verified.catalyst: Union Pacific's definitive cash-and-stock acquisition of Norfolk Southern ($88.82 cash + 1.0 UNP share per NSC share) is live at the STB, with the revised application accepted May 28 2026 and the statutory clock running to a Q1-Q2 2027 final decision and mid-2027 close.
verified.dated_milestone: Next hard date: July 27 2026 — remaining supplemental information responses due to the STB (first tranche filed July 7 2026); proceedings and environmental review are held in abeyance until then, after which the STB issues the procedural schedule. Statutory evidentiary window runs 12 months from the May 28 2026 acceptance; final decision due within 90 days of record close, i.e. Q1-Q2 2027; targeted close mid-2027.
verified.instrument: Long NSC common, optionally hedged 1:1 short UNP to isolate the $88.82 cash stub plus spread
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: Union Pacific, signed definitive merger agreement, shareholder votes already passed) + G2 (concrete commitment: fixed, non-adjusting consideration of $88.82 cash + 1.0 UNP share per NSC share). G3 not met — the spread is the market's explicit priced view of approval odds, not an unpriced figure.
verified.edge: M — the dates and terms are public and heavily covered, so there is no informational edge; the edge is structural (willingness to underwrite an 11-month regulatory hold at a wide spread most equity mandates will not carry). Not a differentiated-insight setup.
verified.primary_source: STB press release PR-26-13, "STB Accepts UP-NS Merger Application for Consideration; Requires Supplemental Information and Holds Proceedings in Abeyance" (May 28 2026, stb.gov); UP/NSC joint release on first-round supplemental responses (July 7 2026, norfolksouthern.com / up.com); merger consideration per UNP S-4/424(b)(3) and NSC DEFM14A (2025, sec.gov). Prices via FMP batch-quote, July 20 2026.
verified.kill_fact: Terms and dates check out against primary sources (STB PR-26-13: unanimous acceptance of the REVISED application May 28 2026, supplemental information due July 27 2026; NSC/UNP 8-Ks: $88.82 cash + 1.0 UNP share, shareholder approvals Nov 14 2025 at ~99%/99.5%; NSC $327.47 vs UNP $286.96 = $375.78 package, $48.31 / ~14.8% gross spread). The line's self-flagged 'cash-and-stock not all-stock' correction is itself correct. But the load-bearing timing claim is WRONG: the same STB decision that accepted the application HELD THE PROCEEDINGS IN ABEYANCE — including the environmental review — and expressly DECLINED to set a procedural schedule, saying it will establish one only in a future decision after reviewing the nine categories of supplemental material. So no evidentiary clock is 'concretely running' to a Q1-Q2 2027 decision; the 12-month evidentiary window is not ticking while the case sits in abeyance, and the mid-2027 close is an issuer aspiration ('early 2027' per the companies), not a statutory date. Also note the original application was outright REJECTED Jan 16 2026 — a completed precedent for further delay, and the reason the spread is 14.8% rather than a normal deal spread. Trade is real, liquid, and hedgeable, but the edge is duration + coin-flip public-interest risk with an INDETERMINATE clock, not a dated catalyst; ~0.74:1 reference R:R does not compensate for open-ended abeyance. Score cut from 6.5 to 5.5 for the timeline misstatement.
verified.analysis: This is a genuine, dated, forward regulatory arb rather than a macro bet: the merger agreement is signed with fixed non-adjusting consideration, shareholder approvals are done, and the only remaining gate is the STB, whose clock is now concretely dated (supplemental filings July 27 2026, evidentiary record closing within 12 months of the May 28 2026 acceptance, decision Q1-Q2 2027). The ~14.8% gross spread is wide precisely because the public-interest test for the first true transcontinental Class I is a real coin-flip-plus risk, and a denial likely returns NSC toward the high-$260s/low-$270s — giving roughly 0.74:1 reference reward-to-risk unhedged, which improves materially on a 1:1 UNP hedge that strips out rail-sector beta. One correction to triage: the deal is cash-and-stock ($88.82 cash + 1.0 UNP), not all-stock, which changes the hedge construction and the downside math. Sized as a hedged position rather than an outright directional bet; edge is structural duration tolerance, not information.
